title: Rethinking Video Autoencoders for Interactive World Models
title_zh: 重新思考面向交互式世界模型的视频自编码器

paragraphs.en: 提出开源因果扩散表征自编码器家族CADRE，系统研究世界模型的视频压缩方式并给出四项发现。 Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre
paragraphs.zh: 提出开源因果扩散表征自编码器家族CADRE，系统研究世界模型的视频压缩方式并给出四项发现。视频世界模型根据过去的帧和动作预测未来的帧。 它们充当模拟器，智能体在其中进行训练、规划或评估，而人类可以与之交互控制。 它们在视频自编码器的潜在空间中生成，该自编码器的压缩方式决定了每帧的成本以及每个动作等待生效的时长。 然而世界模型通常沿用文本到视频生成器的自编码器，这类自编码器为离线生成而构建，没有智能体在其中等待，而且在没有其训练数据和代码的情况下，无法在其他压缩率下重新训练。 因此我们要问：世界模型应该如何压缩、在哪里压缩、压缩到什么程度。 我们构建了CADRE，一个开源的因果扩散表征自编码器家族，涵盖多种时空压缩率。 其成员仅在冻结特征上的一个小瓶颈处有所不同，并共享一个经自蒸馏至一步或几步的扩散解码器。 我们在每个自编码器上训练同一个世界模型，涵盖操作和导航两个领域，每个领域各两个环境。 CADRE在延迟-质量前沿上占据大部分位置，在移动相机的情况下尤其如此。 我们的研究还得出四项发现。 在高压缩率下，扩散解码器比感知回归更清晰。 在机器人操作中，时间压缩在自编码器中比在世界模型中更有效。 操作与导航需要相反的压缩方式：相机静止时时间压缩代价很小，相机移动时则依赖空间压缩。 出人意料的是，在相机静止时，更粗的空间token对运动的伤害远大于对图像质量的伤害。 代码、模型和在线演示见 https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre
